scope: Corollary 1.3 (Finite-rank translated intersections) of the manuscript “The abelian Zilber–Pink conjecture” (preprints/The-Abelian-Zilber-Pink-Conjecture-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 016 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 53e8f20495ac6168), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let A be an abelian variety over Q, let Γ ⊆ A(Q) be a subgroup satisfying dimQ Γ ⊗Z Q  < ∞, and let X ⊆ A be an irreducible closed subvariety of dimension d contained in no translate of a proper algebraic subgroup of A. Then X(Q) ∩ A[d+1] (Q) + Γ  is not Zariski dense in X. If d = 1, this intersection is finite.
